embeds.title: 🟡 Microsoft May Security Update Fails for Some Due to Boot Partition Size Glitch
embeds.description:
Microsoft's May Security Update fails to install on Windows 11 devices with insufficient free space (typically 10MB or less) on the EFI System Partition (ESP), leaving affected systems unprotected. The installation proceeds through initial phases but fails during the reboot phase at approximately 35-36% completion. Microsoft recommended either changing a Windows registry setting to force the update or rolling back changes and waiting for a future fix. Security consultants and IT leaders expressed concern about the reliability of the update process and the enterprise-scale disruption caused by reboot-phase failures.
**Sources:** CSO Online • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** n/a
**Incident date:** 2026-05-18 • **Confidence:** reported
